lines.text:
Oh! Hi! You’re not a Rocket!
You came to save us?
Why, thank you!\c
I want you to have this Pokémon
for saving us.

It’s a Lapras.
It’s a very intelligent Pokémon.\c
We kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you.\c
I think you will be a good Trainer
for Lapras!\c
It loves to swim, so take good care of it, OK?
